extension.name: Work IQ
extension.description: Integrate Microsoft 365 organizational knowledge into spec-driven development workflows
extension.author: sakitA

commands.name: speckit.workiq.ask
commands.description: Ask a natural-language question about your M365 data (emails, meetings, docs, Teams)

commands.name: speckit.workiq.context
commands.description: Gather M365 context (emails, meetings, documents, Teams) for a feature or topic

commands.name: speckit.workiq.stakeholders
commands.description: Discover decision-makers, SMEs, and contributors from M365 activity

commands.name: speckit.workiq.enrich
commands.description: Analyze an existing spec and enrich it with M365 organizational knowledge

hooks.prompt:
Before starting the specification, consider whether M365 organizational context would be
helpful. If the user has Work IQ configured, suggest running `/speckit.workiq.context` to
gather relevant emails, meetings, documents, and Teams messages about the topic.
hooks.description: Optionally gather M365 context before writing a spec
Suggest enriching the spec with M365 data after initial draft
